story: Chatfield State Park is located in Douglas and Jefferson counties of Colorado, United States. The park centers on Chatfield Reservoir, which has a 1,423 acre surface area lake. Over three hundred bird species and a variety of mammals roam the park.
matters: The park hosts over three hundred bird species, both migrant and resident, that frequent the area. The Audubon Society of Greater Denver operates a nature education center here with an emphasis on children and families.
name: Chatfield State Park
